description: The named spawn poses seats and population policies place bodies at; absent, one implicit point at the world origin is declared.

items.description: One named spawn pose available to seats and population policies.

id.description: The stable spawn name, unique within the definition.

position.description: The seat's spawn position: in the world, or in Parent's frame.

yawDegrees.description: The spawn yaw about +Y, in degrees, added to Parent's yaw when it has one.

parent.description: The placement whose composed frame the pose is authored in, or null for a world-space pose. SpawnPoints hands every reader the pose resolved into the world with this member cleared, so a group of rows placed under one root placement keeps its spawn points when the root moves or turns.

items.title: WorldSpawnPoint
